infoPlist.NSHealthClinicalHealthRecordsShareUsageD: RIVAL does not read health records. It only reads workouts from Apple Health.

plugins.photosPermission: RIVAL uses your photos to add pictures and videos to your activities.
plugins.cameraPermission: RIVAL uses the camera to take pictures and videos of your activities.
plugins.microphonePermission: RIVAL uses the microphone to record sound with videos of your activities.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: RIVAL uses location to record the route of a run, walk or ride started in the app.
plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: RIVAL uses location to record the route of a run, walk or ride started in the app, including while the phone is locked.
plugins.motionUsagePermission: RIVAL does not use motion data. Activities are recorded with location only.
plugins.locationAlwaysPermission: RIVAL uses location to record the route of a run, walk or ride started in the app, including while the phone is locked.

plugins.NSHealthShareUsageDescription: RIVAL reads workouts from Apple Health, with their routes, heart rate and calories, so every activity appears in one place.
plugins.NSHealthUpdateUsageDescription: RIVAL does not write to Apple Health. It only reads workouts so every activity appears in one place.
